# New Wave

> The AI stack for professional designers. NwWv Studio makes paid social ad creative on an AI stack, tested and refreshed every week. New Wave is the community: weekly Use / Skip / Watch verdicts, case studies, and agent recipes. Run by creative directors in the United States.

## Offers
- NwWv Studio / Backstop (done-for-you paid social ad creative for Meta and TikTok: static, short video, and copy variants, tested and refreshed weekly). Core $600/mo, Plus $1,000/mo, Premium $1,500/mo, plus $500 setup. Roster capped at 8 clients. Full Agency $9,500/mo plus $2,500 setup, limited to 2 clients. Hiring the studio is not part of membership.
- Creative AI Stack newsletter (weekly, Tuesdays): free top 3 verdicts; paid $12/mo or $120/yr (founding $8/mo for first 100); student $5/mo or $48/yr. Paid includes the Weekly Stack, Case Studies, and 30% off Agent Recipes.
- Case Study Nº 01: how New Wave uses AI agents to win Backstop clients. Public counts are unpublished (shown as em dashes, live from week 1). The full breakdown is Paid. Later case studies come from Paid-member briefs. Not included with Free or Student.
- Agent recipe library: outlined n8n, Zapier, and Claude workflows, not yet tested, $29-99 each, bundles $99-149, Recipe Club $20/mo. Paid members save 30% on every recipe.

## Editorial independence
- Verdicts are never for sale. No pay-to-remove.
- All paid placements are labeled Sponsored, Featured, or Affiliate and sit apart from verdicts.
- Affiliate links only on tools rated Use.
